content: "Senzo Mchunu: Mr Mchunu has since denied what he says are 'wild allegations'"
"Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi: The provincial police chief also alleged Mr Mchunu had ties to a controversial businessman who was 'financially supporting' the minister's political career."

"Ramaphosa was clearly rattled over the weekend - South Africa's TimeLive news site reported he cancelled an official trip to Spain at the last minute as he awaited the DA's decision on the future of the GNU."
